preconditions.description: The length of the binary string n must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'0', '1'} for c in b)
preconditions.description: The binary string b must only contain the characters '0' and '1'.
The length of the binary string b must match the given length n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of moves required to make the string beautiful.
The minimum number of moves must be non-negative.
The resulting string must not contain the substring '010'.
